segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Hi Tom, it is Sam from Northbeam. Thanks for taking my call today.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: No problem. I wanted to ask about your pricing for a team of twenty.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: Of course. Our team plan starts with a monthly subscription and you can add seats any time.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.text: That works. We are comparing a few vendors, so I need something in writing.

segments.speaker: agent
segments.text: I'll send you the pricing sheet by Wednesday.
